thread:
lina: Kicking off v3.1.2-canary deploy. Plan: US micro-canary 2% -> EU canary 5% -> US stagger to 25% -> APAC warm-pool then open. Change window 00:00-04:00 UTC. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1.2% for 3m OR p95 >1100ms. Pin model to q5f3-highmem for this rollout. Release notes: https://redwood/release/v3.1.2

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary start: service=api-gateway variant=v3.1.2-canary region=us slices=1/50 ts=6278900015

omar: Quick capacity check: US hosted pool has 10 spare GPUs, warm-pool at 25% primed. EU dedicated pool low on spare GPUs (1) due to nightly finetune jobs; recommend spinning EU warm-pool +3 GPUs before EU canary.

ops-oncall: Dashboards ready. Alerts: 5xx >=1.2% -> #ops-alerts, p95 >=1100ms -> #ops-alerts. Also set transient alert for KV miss spike >9% and model OOMs.

ryan: Noted on EU. I'll schedule warm-pool spin and throttle finetune at 01:10 UTC to avoid noise. Also prefill token cache for canary keys.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] US canary health @7m: p95=360ms, 5xx=0.2%, cpu=58%, gpu_mem=49% Status=GREEN

lina: Good. Move to EU canary at +18m if US stable. US will hold 2% until EU is green.

release-coordinator: Reminder: pin downstream reranker to 2.0.1-compat in manifest. Also add note for wallets team about potential latency blips for large prompts.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU canary start: service=api-gateway variant=v3.1.2-canary region=eu slices=1/20 ts=6278900042
deploy-bot: [deploybot] EU health @4m: p95=700ms, 5xx=0.6%, kv_miss=11% -> transient spike observed

ops-oncall: KV miss spike looks like key hash mismatch after tokenizer pin. Hold EU and enable cache-prefill + key-normalizer. I'll create transient alert for >10% KV miss.

omar: Applying cache.prefill=true and key_normalizer=v3 now.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Config applied: cache.prefill=true, key_normalizer=v3 ts=6278900055
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Recheck @2m: EU kv_miss=2%, p95=680ms, 5xx=0.4% -> cleared

ryan: EU warm-pool now at +3 GPUs, verified. EU holding at 5% for 25m. If no regressions, proceed with US stagger to 25% (10% -> 25% in two steps). APAC remains warm-standby at 30% until US+EU stable for 1h.

ops-oncall: Heads-up: if US p95 exceeds 1000ms on ramp, we'll try a tactical config: reduce runtime.batch_size from 64->40 and enable async_fallback for long prompts. If that doesn't help in 8m, we execute rollback to v3.0.9-stable for affected region.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] US ramp step 1 -> 10% start ts=6278900060
deploy-bot: [deploybot] US step 1 health @3m: p95=980ms, 5xx=1.4% -> nearing threshold

ops-oncall: Pausing further ramp. Initiate mitigation: applying runtime.batch_size=40 for region=us and async_fallback=enabled now.

ryan: Applying overrides now. Also throttling background enrichment jobs in US for 12m to reduce contention.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Config applied: runtime.batch_size=40, async_fallback=enabled ts=6278900068
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Re-eval @4m: p95=530ms, 5xx=0.5% -> recovered, alert cleared

ops-oncall: Recovery confirmed. Hold at 10% for 20m before next increase. No rollback needed. Add note to release changelog about batch_size override and key-normalizer fix.

lina: Final call: continue staggered US ramp after hold; APAC open only after 1h stable across US+EU. I'll update release notes and notify #release-notes and statuspage for the minor cache normalization change. Thanks team :rocket:
